svg.text: Four steps, and you are already doing the first one
Type pogo where you would have typed curl
Every flag curl takes, pogo takes, and the output is curl's own. What pogo adds is a
record: the response, the status, how long it took.
Hosts that share a domain are one API, and the subdomain says which environment.
api.acme.com and api.staging.acme.com are one thing in two places, not two things.
Change it and run it again
Open a request as fields, edit any of them, and run it as a new entry. The original is
Mark a request with d, press d on another, and pogo diffs the two responses. After a
replay the mark is already set for you.
